stem.en: Which list gives the four dynasties in the order they ruled, from earliest to latest?

feedback.en: The Shang came first. They ruled from 1600 BCE, and the Zhou took over only in 1046 BCE.
The Qin came long after the Zhou. The Zhou ended in 256 BCE, and the Qin empire began in 221 BCE.
The Qin came before the Han. The Han took over in 206 BCE, when the Qin fell.

explanation.en: Shang 1600-1046 BCE, Zhou 1046-256 BCE, Qin 221-206 BCE, Han 206 BCE-220 CE.
